delivery.title: Prices, postage and delivery
delivery.content:
The total price and delivery options available for your order are shown at checkout before you pay. Unless checkout says otherwise, the displayed price includes standard outbound postage and any delivery insurance FlipFlop chooses to buy. Faster or other premium delivery may cost extra; any additional charge is shown before you place the order.

Delivery estimates are based on the supplier, workshop and courier information available when we prepare your order. An estimated date is not a guaranteed delivery date unless checkout expressly identifies it as guaranteed. If an option or estimate changes after you order, we will contact you.

FlipFlop remains responsible for your order until it is delivered to you or to someone you have nominated to receive it, subject to your statutory rights. For help with an order, reply to your order confirmation or email mac@theflipflop.shop with your order number.

returns.title: Change-of-mind returns
returns.content:
If you are a consumer buying online, tell us within 14 days after delivery that you want to cancel. You then have a further 14 days to send the goods back. Contact us before returning an item so we can give you the correct return instructions and address. You do not have to give a reason.

We will refund you within 14 days after receiving the goods back or receiving acceptable evidence that you sent them. We refund the standard delivery charge where one was separately charged; if you chose a more expensive delivery option, the refund is limited to standard delivery. You normally pay the direct cost of change-of-mind return postage unless we tell you otherwise before purchase.

You may handle goods as needed to inspect them. If handling goes beyond what is reasonably necessary to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning, a deduction for diminished value may be made only where the law allows. This change-of-mind process does not replace your rights if goods are faulty, damaged, misdescribed or incorrectly supplied. Contact mac@theflipflop.shop with your order number to start a return.

warranty.title: FlipFlop warranty
warranty.content:
New complete PCs built and sold by FlipFlop include a 12-month FlipFlop commercial warranty starting on the recorded delivery date. The warranty is additional to your statutory rights and does not replace, limit or shorten them. The coverage that applies to your order, including parts and labour, is described in the warranty terms supplied with that order.

For Flip Refresh work, the commercial warranty covers the parts supplied by FlipFlop and FlipFlop's workmanship for the period stated in your order documents. Customer-owned parts retained in the build are not treated as newly supplied parts under that commercial warranty. This does not affect any statutory rights that apply to the service or goods.

If you think a covered item has developed a fault, contact mac@theflipflop.shop with your order number, a description of the problem and any helpful photos. We will explain the next steps. Any exclusions or limits apply only as stated in the terms for your order and where permitted by law.

payments.title: Payment methods and instalments
payments.content:
Checkout is processed by Stripe. The payment methods shown at checkout are the methods enabled for and available to you and your specific order. Depending on eligibility and availability, these may include payment cards, digital wallets, Amazon Pay or Klarna. The checkout page shows the options available before you confirm payment.

Klarna and Amazon Pay are separate providers. They decide whether their services or any pay-later or instalment option are available, and set their own approval decisions, payment schedules, interest, fees and terms. FlipFlop does not lend money or guarantee provider approval. Do not rely on a financing option unless the provider presents it for your purchase and you have reviewed its terms.

Where a refund is due, FlipFlop sends it to the original payment method. A wallet or instalment provider controls when its account or payment schedule reflects that refund. Contact the provider about how it appears in your provider account; contact mac@theflipflop.shop about the FlipFlop order or refund itself.

cancellations.title: Order cancellations and changes
cancellations.content:
For direct orders, you can cancel through the available self-service option before components are ordered and receive a full refund. Before components are ordered, you can also ask to change your order. We pause sourcing while we review compatibility, price and timing, and a requested change takes effect only when we confirm it.

Once components have been ordered, contact mac@theflipflop.shop to discuss a cancellation or change. We will explain any supplier commitments or work already completed and assess the request under your order terms and applicable law. We will not treat this process as removing any cancellation or other statutory right that applies to your order.

If you are exercising an online consumer right to cancel, use the instructions in the Returns policy or contact us with your order number. Some clearly personalised goods may have different statutory cancellation rules; we will tell you before purchase if an exception applies to a particular product.

faults.title: Faults and your statutory rights
faults.content:
Your statutory rights apply in addition to any FlipFlop commercial warranty. Goods must be of satisfactory quality, fit for purpose and as described. If goods do not meet those requirements, the remedies available depend on the circumstances and may include repair or replacement, a price reduction or rejection of the goods. Qualifying faults may give you a short-term right to reject goods within 30 days.

If you ask for or agree to a repair or replacement, it must be provided within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience, and necessary costs such as postage must be covered where the law requires. The law also sets rules about faults discovered in the first six months and about later claims. Time limits for bringing a claim are generally six years in England and Wales and five years in Scotland; these are limits for legal claims, not a promise that every product will last that long.

If something is wrong with your order, contact mac@theflipflop.shop with your order number, a description of the issue and any useful photos. We will explain the available next steps. We will not ask you to pay return postage for faulty, damaged, misdescribed or incorrectly supplied goods where the law requires us to cover it.

delivery-damage.title: Delivery damage and delivery problems
delivery-damage.content:
If a parcel appears damaged, photograph it before opening where practical. Keep all packaging and take photos of any damage to the product. Contact mac@theflipflop.shop promptly with your order number, tracking reference and photos so we can help. If an order has not arrived, tell us as soon as possible.

Please keep the parcel, packaging, delivery label and any carrier incident or damage reference until we have advised you what is needed. We may ask for information that helps us investigate with the carrier or insurer. If theft is suspected, tell us and provide any relevant police reference if one is available.

FlipFlop will handle the carrier or insurer process where applicable. Insurance terms govern the insurer relationship; they do not reduce your rights against FlipFlop. Contact us promptly because carrier and insurer processes can have short reporting deadlines.
